# TimeControl

> > TimeControl is a comprehensive web-based timesheet and time-tracking software designed for finance, project management, payroll, and HR operations.

TimeControl, developed by HMS Software in Quebec, Canada, is one of the world's most popular timesheet systems serving enterprises globally. The platform offers both SaaS cloud and on-premise deployment options with mobile apps for iOS and Android, integrations with tools like Primavera, and proven success across diverse industries from construction to technology.

## Key Topics

- Timesheet Software
- Time Tracking
- Project Management
- Finance Management
- Project Tracking
- SaaS Cloud Solutions
- On-Premise Deployment
- Mobile Apps (iOS/Android)
- Payroll Management
- HR Integration
- Primavera Integration
- Crew-Based Timekeeping
- Compliance Tracking
- Customer Testimonials
- Enterprise Solutions
